name: kamod-ui
description: Lightweight UI components for Preact and Tailwind: composable primitives you can customize, extend, and ship without a heavy runtime. Open source; source is meant to be read and adapted.
author: Klaus Zahiragic <watzak>

scripts.build:docs: pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/themes build && pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/typeset build && pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/ui build && pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/ui-motion build && pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/openui build && pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/blocks build && pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/ui-docs build
scripts.test:ci: pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/themes build && pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/typeset build && pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/themes test && pnpm test && pnpm test:openui && pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/ui-motion test && pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/ui build && pnpm docs:components --check --no-build && pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/ui-motion build && pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/openui build && pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/blocks build && pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/blocks test && pnpm test:docs
scripts.test:a11y: pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/ui test:a11y && pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/themes build && pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/typeset build && pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/ui-docs exec playwright test e2e/a11y.spec.ts --project=chromium
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/themes typecheck:emit && pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/typeset typecheck:emit && pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/ui typecheck:emit && pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/ui-motion typecheck:emit && pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/openui typecheck:emit && pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/blocks typecheck && pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/ui-docs typecheck
scripts.lint:a11y: pnpm exec oxlint --jsx-a11y-plugin -A all -D jsx-a11y/alt-text -D jsx-a11y/aria-props -D jsx-a11y/aria-role -D jsx-a11y/aria-unsupported-elements -D jsx-a11y/heading-has-content -D jsx-a11y/html-has-lang -D jsx-a11y/iframe-has-title -D jsx-a11y/no-access-key -D jsx-a11y/no-autofocus -D jsx-a11y/no-distracting-elements -D jsx-a11y/scope -D jsx-a11y/tabindex-no-positive -D jsx-a11y/role-has-required-aria-props packages
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm format:check && pnpm biome:ci && pnpm lint && pnpm test:ci && pnpm build
scripts.qa:publint: pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/themes publint && pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/ui publint && pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/openui publint && pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/ui-motion publint
scripts.qa:attw: pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/themes attw && pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/ui attw && pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/openui attw && pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/ui-motion attw
scripts.qa:package: pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/ui build && pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/openui build && pnpm qa:publint && pnpm qa:attw
scripts.qa:openui: pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/openui test && pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/openui build && pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/openui publint && pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/openui attw
scripts.release:check: pnpm test:ci && pnpm build && pnpm qa:publint && pnpm qa:attw
scripts.release:auth: npm whoami --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org || (echo 'Authenticate with: npm login (or set NODE_AUTH_TOKEN)' >&2; exit 1)
scripts.release:quick: pnpm install && pnpm release:check:package && pnpm release:auth && pnpm release:publish
